name: data-display/sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A word-sized line chart you can scrub.

files.content:
export { Sparkline } from './Sparkline';
export type { SparklinePoint, SparklineProps } from './Sparkline';

keyboard.action: Focus the chart to inspect it.
Move to the next or previous point.
Go to the first or last point.

notes: The drawing is an image with a written summary as its name: range, lowest and highest.
The scrubber is a `slider` whose value text is the point’s label and value, such as “Thu: 1.8 m”.
A disclosure reveals the full data as a table with row headers.
The highlighted point is drawn as a ring and a guide line, not by colour alone.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Nothing animates; the readout updates instantly.
